name: atproto-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is atproto, the AT Protocol SDK for Python: an autogenerated, typed, sync and
async SDK for Bluesky and other AT Protocol services. Its high-level `atproto_client` package provides the
`Client` and `AsyncClient` (login and session handling, posting helpers such as `send_post`, `send_image` and
`send_images`), the `TextBuilder` rich-text utility and the generated record and embed models they build.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the high-level client layer of the atproto_client package under packages/atproto_client/: its top-level modules, the Client and AsyncClient with their session, header and time mixins and raw clients under client/, the TextBuilder utility under utils/, the model helper modules directly under models/, and the post, rich-text facet, embed and repository record and blob models the posting helpers build (models/app/bsky/feed/post.py, models/app/bsky/richtext/, models/app/bsky/embed/, and models/com/atproto/repo/strong_ref.py, create_record.py and upload_blob.py), together with README.md, the client documentation pages under docs/source/atproto_client/, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go awa
